llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed wrapper for a third-party image generation CLI, with expected network/API-key use and no hidden local code in the artifact.

dimensions.detail: Prompts, parameters, and referenced local media files may be sent to dLazy endpoints, which is proportionate for a cloud image generation service and is disclosed in the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation uses a pinned npm package or npx invocation for @dlazy/cli@1.2.3; this is disclosed, but users are still trusting an external CLI package.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The trigger terms include generic image-generation phrases and the document uses strong agent wording for error handling, but those instructions stay within the skill's intended workflow.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The CLI may save a dLazy API key under ~/.dlazy/config.json for future use; the storage location and revocation/rotation path are disclosed, and no background persistence or privilege escalation is shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Nano Banana 2 image generation/editing, and the instructions consistently route use through the dLazy CLI and hosted API.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable using dLazy's hosted service: prompts and local image paths may be uploaded, generated files are hosted on dLazy storage, and the CLI can save an API key locally. Prefer npx if you do not want a persistent global binary, review the pinned npm package/source, and avoid passing private local files unless you intend to upload them.
llm.findings:
[AE1] expected: The referenced English and Chinese skill files were both present and inspected; the scanner's coverage concern does not hold for this adjudication.
[SQP-1] expected: Generic image-generation trigger phrases could cause broad routing, but they match the skill's purpose and do not by themselves show hidden or unrelated behavior.
[SDI-1] expected: The artifact discloses upload of local media paths to dLazy storage; the video/audio wording is broader than the shown banana2 image options, so users should treat any local file argument as uploadable.
[P9] expected: The long spaces occur in markdown tables for formatting; manual inspection found no concealed instructions after the padding.
[SQP-3] expected: The mandatory wording directs error handling for insufficient credits or missing API keys; it is promotional/operational but scoped to this service's normal failure cases.
[SDI-4] unexpected: The examples use --image while the options list documents --images; this is a documentation inconsistency, not a security-impacting hidden capability.
[aig-skill-scan] expected: The supplied A.I.G SARIF contained no results and reported only markdown artifacts with no embedded executable scripts.
